City of Shelby Façade Improvement Assistance Application DUE: 05/ 10 /202 4 Business Name Grant Applicant Cost Estimate Address Phone Date of Application The City of Shelby will help commercial property and business owners improve the appearance of their storefronts by providing grants for part of the cost of eligible improvements. Eligible Improvements Eligible improvements include: Exterior painting, signage, awnings, storefront/facade cleaning and/or restoration; sidewalks, lighting, storefront security devices, new roof, permanent flower boxes and planters, and related exterior improvements. Applications will not be accepted to finance improvements already completed. Grants are limited to one grant per business and or storefront per year. Application must be complete and include a visual representation of the work to be completed with estimates from a bonafide trade person, contractor, or supplier, that is registered in the City. Completed applications will be reviewed within 30 days of receipt by the Façade Improvement Committee. Description of Improvements to be made: All improvements must comply with all City building code and sign size standards. All improvements must be performed within 120 days of approval unless a written extension is granted by the City. The City of Shelby reserves the right to turn down an application if the applicant's improvement is not consistent with the overall image of the Central Business District or the area in which the busi ness resides.
